All special requirements are locked: 100% pure Jain catering, airport & sightseeing wheelchair assistance for Mataji, and premium Downtown / Sheikh Zayed Road 4-star family suites. Tax breakdown: For ₹4,50,000 package, statutory TCS is 5% (₹22,500, fully adjustable against your advance tax), and B2B GST invoice with your firm's GSTIN will be provided. Detailed itinerary options are ready for your review.
